# Fixture config for the scenario pack. Paths are relative to this file.
version: 1
mode: observe
strict: true
environments:
  - name: prod
    tier: protected
    match:
      paths: ["envs/prod/**", "envs/prod-*/**"]
      workspaces: ["prod", "production"]
      backends: ["s3://acme-tf-state-prod/*"]
      aws_profiles: ["prod-admin", "prod-*"]
      kube_contexts: ["eks-blue"]
      gcp_projects: ["acme-payments-9f2"]
      azure_subscriptions: ["Payments"]
  - name: staging
    tier: standard
    match:
      paths: ["envs/staging/**", "envs/qa/**", "envs/shared/**"]
      workspaces: ["staging"]
      aws_profiles: ["staging"]
  - name: dev
    tier: disposable
    match:
      paths: ["envs/dev/**", "envs/sandbox/**"]
      aws_profiles: ["dev", "sandbox"]
      kube_contexts: ["kind-*"]
  # Terragrunt-style layout: the "prod" name hint must not match "non-prod".
  - name: non-prod
    tier: standard
    match:
      paths: ["non-prod/**"]
# Addresses whose destroy or replace is critical whatever the type (spec: protected_resources).
protected_resources: ["aws_instance.bastion"]
# A team's own credential runner: company-run PROFILE COMMAND...
wrappers:
  - name: company-run
    skip: 1
    profile_arg: 1
